title: Mixing: Born In A Prison by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Phil Spector

The final mixing session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Some Time In New York City album took place on 20 March 1972.

The last song to be completed was ‘Born In A Prison’. This was also the couple’s third wedding anniversary.

Page last updated: 12 March 2026
